title: AGI: Robots Awake by marcvscouto
excerpt: The lab robots woke up. Grab the keycard, reach the door, see how far you get.
content_html:
AI DisclosureAI Assisted, Code, Graphics, Sounds, Text

Designed and directed by Marcvs: concept, rules, balance, story and art direction, iterated through playtesting. Code, in-game text and the cover were produced with Claude (Anthropic) under my direction. There are no generated images or audio files: every sprite is drawn by code and every sound is synthesized by code, at runtime.
